name: get-dynamicgroupfilterreport
title: Dynamic Distribution Group Filter Report
shortDescription: Exports Exchange Online Dynamic Distribution Group recipient filters and highlights negative filter operators for review.
longDescription: Connects to Exchange Online with certificate-based app-only authentication, retrieves Dynamic Distribution Groups, and exports recipient filter configuration and related attributes to a timestamped CSV report.
Flags negative filter operators as indicators for manual review. The script does not modify groups or calculate actual recipient membership.
